protocol: Before CHECK-IN 3, enumerate every assumption and approximation the delivered claims rest on: plan premises, declared approximations, deviations, substituted inputs, untested extrapolations and stated-input values. Locate each one in a pinned record.

Grade each item with an integer severity from 1 to 10 for its possible effect on a delivered claim, and mark it controlled only when a located check, variation or receipt bounds its effect. A citation or an opinion does not control an item.

Return the audit as an assumption-audit record (schema_version 1, items with id, statement, severity, controlled and locators). Every uncontrolled item at or above the K8 severity floor must appear in the delivered result; the computed check refuses delivery otherwise.
Never lower a severity to fit the result, merge distinct assumptions to hide one, or mark an item controlled by the claim it supports.

Give every finding an evidence class (new_receipt, code_check, cited or opinion) and the receipt, check or locator IDs behind it. Only new_receipt, code_check or a typed discriminating-test request can block; cited claims and opinions stay advisory. Ask for the cheapest discriminating test that could invalidate the claim.
Report public rationales and located evidence. Never accept your own work, widen approval or erase an unresolved obligation.
